body: Minor release: the invite inbox on the overview (T-233) with its follow-up (T-234), the cuneiform rendering fix for the web client (T-231), and the server hardening from the API security review (T-235, T-236, T-237). Supersedes 2.1.0; 2.1.1 was dropped before publication. Server, web and Android all change (Android: the overview's Invitations and Ignored sections).
title: Release 2.2.0
